shown.message:
I accepted the idea review's request #7 and closed it. I made both choices in Brief rev. 5 (wiki commit ac40f7c), under "Floor and eligibility".

- **Floor:** it gives the model all of its observed cells in the selectable pool, so the run-set size differs per model.
- **Eligibility:** a (model, split) pair counts at k only if the model has at least k observed cells in the pool. It also needs at least m_T = max(3, ⌈|T|/3⌉) observed cells in the target set.
- **Ineligible pairs:** these are dropped, not imputed. A model enters a given k only if it is eligible in at least 20 splits or half of the splits, whichever is smaller.
- **Reporting:** the number of eligible models and pairs is reported for each k and for the floor.
- **Headline curve:** it uses the fixed set of models eligible at k_max, so the model set doesn't change along the k axis. The curve of all models eligible at each k is a labelled supplement. This replaces the old run-set-based rule.

I commented on `experiment-repo`'s issue #2 so it carries this into the pre-registration record. That record is still unwritten, and my commitment issue #2 stays open.
